items.title: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 75% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 9.8.

w5h.what_impacted: Systems running Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
w5h.technology: Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) (CVE-2026-111560)
w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-11-13)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; EPSS puts exploitation probability at 75% within 30 days; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached; edge/network devices are internet-facing and a top initial-access vector.

impact.affected_versions: Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Identify all internet-facing Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) devices. Check firmware versions against the advisory, and review access logs for unauthorized access, unusual processes, or configuration changes.

items.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
